<?php
namespace App\Http\Controllers\Dashboard;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Runtime;

final class OwnerDashboardFilesController extends Controller
{
    public function show(string $path)
    {
        abort_unless(Runtime::tenant(),404);
        // The login logo is a bundled asset. Tenant account/business media requires its own authenticated session.
        abort_unless($path==='owner-dashboard-logo.png'||auth('admin')->check(),403);
        abort_if(str_contains($path,"\0")||preg_match('#(?:^|/)[.]{1,2}(?:/|$)#',$path),404);
        $root=realpath(storage_path('app/public'));$file=realpath(storage_path('app/public/'.$path));
        abort_unless($root&&$file&&str_starts_with($file,$root.DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)&&is_file($file),404);
        $extension=strtolower(pathinfo($file,PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        abort_unless(in_array($extension,['jpg','jpeg','png','gif','webp','ico','pdf','mp4','mp3'],true),404);
        return response()->file($file,['Cache-Control'=>'private, no-store','X-Content-Type-Options'=>'nosniff']);
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Http\Controllers\Dashboard;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Registry;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

final class OwnersController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Registry $registry){$owners=$registry->listing(auth('admin')->user());return view('admin.owners.index',compact('owners'));}
    public function create(Registry $registry){$registry->authorize(auth('admin')->user());$owner=null;return view('admin.owners.form',compact('owner'));}
    public function edit(string $owner,Registry $registry){$owner=$registry->show(auth('admin')->user(),$owner);return view('admin.owners.form',compact('owner'));}
    public function store(Request $request,Registry $registry){$id=$registry->save(auth('admin')->user(),$request->all());return redirect()->route('owners.edit',$id)->with('success','تم تسجيل الأونر. جاري تجهيز لوحته المستقلة.');}
    public function update(Request $request,string $owner,Registry $registry){$registry->save(auth('admin')->user(),$request->all(),$owner);return redirect()->route('owners.edit',$owner)->with('success','تم استلام التعديلات. سيظهر رابط الدخول عند اكتمال تطبيقها.');}
    public function state(Request $request,string $owner,Registry $registry){$registry->transition(auth('admin')->user(),$owner,(string)$request->input('state'));return redirect()->route('owners.index')->with('success','تم تحديث حالة الأونر.');}
    public function status(string $owner,Registry $registry){return response()->json($registry->show(auth('admin')->user(),$owner))->header('Cache-Control','private, no-store');}
}

<?php
namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Runtime;
use Closure;

final class OwnerDashboardGuard
{
    public function handle($request,Closure $next)
    {
        if(!Runtime::tenant()){
            abort_if(preg_match('/^go-[0-9a-f]{16}\./D',strtolower($request->getHost())),404);
            return $next($request);
        }
        $r=Runtime::facts();
        abort_if($request->is('clear-cache-admin'),403);
        abort_unless($r['state']==='active'&&!Runtime::blocked($r['id']),403,'هذه اللوحة موقوفة مؤقتًا.');
        $response=$next($request);
        $response->headers->set('Cache-Control','private, no-store');
        $response->headers->set('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff');
        return $response;
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Providers;

use App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Runtime;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\{Gate,Route};
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

final class OwnerDashboardServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register()
    {
        if(!Runtime::tenant())return;
        $r=Runtime::facts();
        // These invariants also apply on the first uncached initialization boot.
        $this->app['config']->set('database.default','mysql');
        $connection=$this->app['config']->get('database.connections.mysql');
        if(($connection['database']??'')!==$r['database']||($connection['username']??'')!==$r['db_user'])
            throw new \RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_DATABASE_BINDING_MISMATCH');
        $this->app['config']->set('database.connections',['mysql'=>$connection]);
        $this->app['config']->set('session.cookie','go_owner_'.str_replace('-','',$r['id']));
        $this->app['config']->set('session.path',$r['prefix']?:'/');
        $this->app['config']->set('session.domain',null);
        $this->app['config']->set('session.driver','file');
        $this->app['config']->set('session.files',$r['base'].'/storage/framework/sessions');
        $this->app['config']->set('cache.default','database');
        $this->app['config']->set('cache.prefix','go_owner_'.$r['id']);
        $this->app['config']->set('queue.default','database');
        $this->app['config']->set('desktop_dashboard.enabled',false);
        $this->app['config']->set('desktop_dashboard.workspace_enabled',false);
        $this->app['config']->set('desktop_dashboard.local',false);
        $this->app['config']->set('settings.auto_discover_settings',[]);
        $this->app['config']->set('app.debug',false);
        $this->app['config']->set('services.fcm.project_id','');
        $this->app['config']->set('services.google.client_id',null);
        $this->app['config']->set('services.google.android_client_id',null);
        $this->app['config']->set('cors.allowed_origins',isset($r['origin'])?[$r['origin']]:[]);
        $this->app['config']->set('cors.supports_credentials',false);
        $publicRoot=$r['base'].'/storage/app/public';
        foreach($this->app['config']->get('filesystems.disks',[])as$name=>$disk){
            if(($disk['driver']??'')==='local'&&isset($disk['root'])&&($disk['root']===$publicRoot||str_starts_with($disk['root'],$publicRoot.'/')))
                $this->app['config']->set('filesystems.disks.'.$name.'.url',rtrim($this->app['config']->get('app.url'),'/').'/storage'.substr($disk['root'],strlen($publicRoot)));
        }
    }

    public function boot()
    {
        if(!Runtime::tenant())return;
        \App\Services\OwnerDashboards\PaymentSettings::load();
        if(isset(Runtime::facts()['origin'])){
            $this->app['url']->forceRootUrl(Runtime::facts()['origin']);
            $this->app['url']->forceScheme('https');
        }
        Gate::before(function($user,$ability){
            // A local business owner has all business abilities. Control-plane actions use Registry::authorize, not Gate.
            return (int)$user->id===1&&$user->account_type==='admin'&&$user->status==='accepted'?true:null;
        });
        Route::middleware('web')->get('storage/{path}',[\App\Http\Controllers\Dashboard\OwnerDashboardFilesController::class,'show'])->where('path','.*');
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

final class AccountPolicy
{
    public static function enforce($request,$actor): void
    {
        if(!Runtime::tenant())return;
        $route=$request->route();if(!$route)return;
        $action=$route->getActionName();
        if(!str_contains($action,'Dashboard\\UserController@'))return;
        $method=$route->getActionMethod();
        $parameter=$route->parameter('user');$id=is_object($parameter)?(int)$parameter->id:(int)$parameter;
        $bulk=$request->input('ids',[]);$ids=is_array($bulk)?$bulk:explode(',',(string)$bulk);
        if($id===1){
            abort_unless((int)$actor->id===1,403,'حساب أونر اللوحة يديره الأونر الرئيسي أو صاحب الحساب.');
            abort_if(in_array($method,['destroy','changeStatus'],true),403,'إيقاف أو حذف حساب الأونر يتم من الأونر الرئيسي.');
        }
        if(in_array($method,['deleteAll','delete_all'],true))abort_if(in_array(1,array_map('intval',$ids),true),403);
    }
}

    public function __construct(string $basePath,string $public){$this->ownerPublic=$public;parent::__construct($basePath);}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

use RuntimeException;

final class Bootstrap
{
    public static function read(string $file,bool $initializing=false): array
    {
        if(is_link($file)||!is_file($file))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_RUNTIME_MISSING');
        $r=json_decode(file_get_contents($file),true,32,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        if(($r['format']??null)!==1||!preg_match('/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/D',$r['id']??'')
            ||!preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/D',$r['slug']??'')
            ||$r['prefix']!==''||!preg_match('/^go-'.preg_quote($r['slug'],'/').'\.[a-z0-9.-]+$/D',$r['host']??'')
            ||$r['origin']!=='https://'.$r['host']
            ||$r['base']!=='/home/fasakha/go-owner-dashboards/tenants/'.$r['id']
            ||$r['public']!=='/home/fasakha/public_html/public/dashboards/'.$r['slug']
            ||dirname($file)!==$r['base']||realpath($r['base'])!==$r['base']
            ||realpath($r['public'])!==$r['public'])throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_RUNTIME_INVALID');
        if(!$initializing){
            if($r['state']!=='active'||Runtime::blocked($r['id']))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_DASHBOARD_DISABLED');
            $cache=$r['base'].'/bootstrap/cache/config.php';
            if(is_link($cache)||!is_file($cache)||!hash_equals($r['config_sha256']??'',hash_file('sha256',$cache)))
                throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_CONFIG_NOT_READY');
        }
        return $r;
    }

    public static function application(array $r): Application
    {
        $app=new Application($r['base'],$r['public']);
        $app->instance('owner.dashboard.runtime',$r);
        $app->instance('path.public',$r['public']);
        $app->useStoragePath($r['base'].'/storage');
        $app->singleton(\Illuminate\Contracts\Http\Kernel::class,\App\Http\Kernel::class);
        $app->singleton(\Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class,\App\Console\Kernel::class);
        $app->singleton(\Illuminate\Contracts\Debug\ExceptionHandler::class,\App\Exceptions\Handler::class);
        return $app;
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

final class ControlSchema
{
    public static function ensure(): void
    {
        if(Runtime::tenant())throw new \RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_CONTROL_PLANE_FORBIDDEN');
        if(!Schema::hasTable('owner_dashboards'))Schema::create('owner_dashboards',function(Blueprint $t){
            $t->engine='InnoDB';$t->uuid('id')->primary();$t->string('slug',16)->unique();
            $t->string('name',130);$t->string('email',191)->unique();$t->string('mobile',32)->nullable();
            $t->string('password_hash',255);$t->unsignedBigInteger('created_by');
            $t->string('desired_state',16)->default('active');$t->string('state',16)->default('pending');
            $t->unsignedBigInteger('revision')->default(1);$t->unsignedBigInteger('applied_revision')->default(0);
            $t->string('error_code',80)->nullable();$t->timestamps();$t->index(['state','revision']);
        });
        $required=['id','slug','name','email','mobile','password_hash','created_by','desired_state','state',
            'revision','applied_revision','error_code','created_at','updated_at'];
        if(array_diff($required,Schema::getColumnListing('owner_dashboards')))throw new \RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_CONTROL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH');
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\{Crypt,DB,Schema,Validator};

/** Tenant payment credentials live in its own encrypted settings, never in an editable database environment file. */
final class PaymentSettings
{
    public const KEYS=['PAYMOB_API_KEY','PAYMOB_CARD_INTEGRATION_ID','PAYMOB_CARD_IFRAME_ID','PAYMOB_MOBILE_WALLET_INTEGRATION_ID'];
    public static function values(): array
    {
        if(!Runtime::tenant()||!Schema::hasTable('settings'))return[];
        $payload=DB::table('settings')->where('group','owner_integrations')->where('name','paymob')->value('payload');
        if($payload===null)return[];
        $values=json_decode(Crypt::decryptString(json_decode($payload,true,16,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),true,16,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        return array_intersect_key($values,array_flip(self::KEYS));
    }
    public static function save(array $input): void
    {
        abort_unless(Runtime::tenant(),403);
        $rules=[];foreach(self::KEYS as$key)$rules[$key]=$key==='PAYMOB_API_KEY'?'nullable|string|max:8192|regex:/^[^\r\n\x00]*$/D':'nullable|string|max:32|regex:/^[0-9]*$/D';
        $values=Validator::make($input,$rules)->validate();
        $payload=json_encode(Crypt::encryptString(json_encode($values,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        DB::table('settings')->updateOrInsert(['group'=>'owner_integrations','name'=>'paymob'],['locked'=>0,'payload'=>$payload]);
    }
    public static function load(): void
    {
        $values=self::values();
        foreach(self::KEYS as$key){$value=(string)($values[$key]??'');putenv($key.'='.$value);$_ENV[$key]=$value;$_SERVER[$key]=$value;}
        config(['dashboard_payments.integrations.online'=>env('PAYMOB_CARD_INTEGRATION_ID'),
            'dashboard_payments.integrations.v_cash'=>env('PAYMOB_MOBILE_WALLET_INTEGRATION_ID')]);
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

use App\Services\Dashboard\DashboardLoginIdentity;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\{DB, Hash, Schema, Validator};
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/** Only the primary owner's installation has this control-plane table. */
final class Registry
{
    private string $control;
    public function __construct(?string $controlDirectory=null){$this->control=$controlDirectory??Runtime::control();}
    private const PUBLIC_FIELDS = ['id','slug','name','email','mobile','desired_state','state','revision',
        'applied_revision','error_code','created_at','updated_at'];

    public function authorize(?object $actor): void
    {
        abort_unless(Runtime::primary($actor),403);
        $fresh=DB::table('users')->where('id',1)->first(['id','account_type','status']);
        abort_unless($fresh && $fresh->account_type==='admin' && $fresh->status==='accepted',403);
        abort_unless(Schema::hasTable('owner_dashboards') && is_dir($this->control.'/deny'),503,
            'إدارة الأونرز غير مفعّلة على السيرفر بعد.');
    }

    public function listing(?object $actor)
    {
        $this->authorize($actor);
        return DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('desired_state','<>','deleted')->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->paginate(20,self::PUBLIC_FIELDS);
    }

    public function show(?object $actor,string $id): object
    {
        $this->authorize($actor); $this->id($id);
        $row=DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('id',$id)->where('desired_state','<>','deleted')->first(self::PUBLIC_FIELDS);
        abort_unless($row,404); return $row;
    }

    public function save(?object $actor,array $input,?string $id=null): string
    {
        $this->authorize($actor); if($id!==null)$this->id($id);
        $input['email']=mb_strtolower(trim((string)($input['email']??'')));
        $data=Validator::make($input,[
            'name'=>'required|string|min:2|max:130','email'=>['required','email','max:191',Rule::unique('owner_dashboards','email')->ignore($id)],
            'mobile'=>'nullable|string|max:32','password'=>($id===null?'required':'nullable').'|string|min:8|max:72|confirmed',
        ])->validate();
        $mobile=empty($data['mobile'])?null:DashboardLoginIdentity::mobile($data['mobile']);
        if(!empty($data['mobile'])&&$mobile===null)throw ValidationException::withMessages(['mobile'=>'اكتب رقم موبايل مصري صحيح.']);
        return DB::transaction(function()use($id,$data,$mobile): string{
            $changes=['name'=>$data['name'],'email'=>$data['email'],'mobile'=>$mobile,'updated_at'=>now()];
            if(!empty($data['password']))$changes['password_hash']=Hash::make($data['password']);
            if($id===null){
                $id=(string)Str::uuid();$changes+=['id'=>$id,'slug'=>bin2hex(random_bytes(8)),
                    'created_by'=>1,'desired_state'=>'active','state'=>'pending','revision'=>1,'applied_revision'=>0,'created_at'=>now()];
                DB::table('owner_dashboards')->insert($changes);
            }else{
                $row=DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('id',$id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
                abort_unless($row&&$row->desired_state!=='deleted',404);
                $this->deny($id,(int)$row->revision+1); // A future revision marker cannot be cleared by an older worker.
                $changes+=['revision'=>(int)$row->revision+1,'state'=>'pending','error_code'=>null];
                DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('id',$id)->update($changes);
            }
            return $id;
        });
    }

    public function transition(?object $actor,string $id,string $state): void
    {
        $this->authorize($actor);$this->id($id);abort_unless(in_array($state,['active','suspended','deleted'],true),422);
        DB::transaction(function()use($id,$state){
            $row=DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('id',$id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            abort_unless($row&&$row->desired_state!=='deleted',404);
            $this->deny($id,(int)$row->revision+1);
            DB::table('owner_dashboards')->where('id',$id)->update(['desired_state'=>$state,'state'=>'pending',
                'revision'=>(int)$row->revision+1,'error_code'=>null,'updated_at'=>now()]);
        });
    }

    public static function url(object $row): string
    {
        $host=preg_replace('/^www\./i','',(string)parse_url(config('app.url'),PHP_URL_HOST));
        return 'https://go-'.$row->slug.'.'.$host.'/admin/login';
    }
    private function id(string $id): void { abort_unless(preg_match('/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/D',$id),404); }
    private function deny(string $id,int $revision): void
    {
        $directory=$this->control.'/deny';abort_unless(is_dir($directory)&&!is_link($directory),503);
        $path=$directory.'/'.$id;abort_if(is_link($path),503);
        $handle=@fopen($path,'c');abort_unless($handle,503,'تعذر تأمين إيقاف اللوحة قبل تحديثها.');
        $value=(string)$revision;
        try{abort_unless(flock($handle,LOCK_EX)&&ftruncate($handle,0)&&fwrite($handle,$value)===strlen($value)&&fflush($handle),503);}
        finally{fclose($handle);}
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services\OwnerDashboards;

/** Set by the trusted tenant entry point, never by an HTTP parameter or a user role. */
final class Runtime
{
    public static function tenant(): bool { return app()->bound('owner.dashboard.runtime'); }
    public static function facts(): array { return self::tenant() ? app('owner.dashboard.runtime') : []; }
    public static function prefix(): string { return self::facts()['prefix'] ?? ''; }
    public static function control(): string { return '/home/fasakha/go-owner-dashboards/control'; }
    public static function blocked(string $id): bool
    {
        $file=self::control().'/deny/'.$id;clearstatcache(true,$file);
        return is_link($file)||!is_file($file)||@file_get_contents($file)!=='';
    }
    public static function primary(?object $actor): bool
    {
        return !self::tenant() && !config('desktop_dashboard.local') && $actor
            && (int)$actor->id === 1 && $actor->account_type === 'admin' && $actor->status === 'accepted';
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);
ini_set('display_errors','0');ini_set('log_errors','0');
try{
    if(PHP_SAPI!=='cli'||$argc!==2||!in_array($argv[1],['--inspect','--install'],true))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_SETUP_ARGUMENTS');
    $root='/home/fasakha/public_html';chdir($root);require $root.'/vendor/autoload.php';
    $app=require $root.'/bootstrap/app.php';$app->make(\Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();
    $db=$app->make('db')->connection();$c=$db->getConfig();
    if($db->getDriverName()!=='mysql'||!in_array($c['host'],['localhost','127.0.0.1','::1'],true))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_LOCAL_MYSQL_REQUIRED');
    if(!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/D',$db->getDatabaseName()))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_DATABASE_NAME');
    $owner=$db->table('users')->where('id',1)->first(['id','account_type','status']);
    if(!$owner||$owner->account_type!=='admin'||$owner->status!=='accepted')throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_PRIMARY_REQUIRED');
    $url=rtrim((string)config('app.url'),'/');
    if(!preg_match('#^https://[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+$#D',$url))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_HTTPS_URL_REQUIRED');
    if(config('cors.supports_credentials'))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_PRIMARY_CORS_REVIEW_REQUIRED');
    if($argv[1]==='--install')\App\Services\OwnerDashboards\ControlSchema::ensure();
    $defaults=[];
    foreach((new ReflectionClass(\App\Models\GeneralSettings::class))->getProperties(ReflectionProperty::IS_PUBLIC)as$property){
        if($property->isStatic()||$property->getDeclaringClass()->getName()!==\App\Models\GeneralSettings::class)continue;
        $type=$property->getType();$defaults[$property->getName()]=$type instanceof ReflectionNamedType&&$type->getName()==='bool'?false:'';
    }
    foreach(['min_order_price','service_fees','km_price','vendor_tax','tax','app_balance','shipping_km_price','shipping_min_price','shipping_cancelled_block_no','min_wallet','default_0_1','default_1_2','default_2_3']as$name)$defaults[$name]='0';
    $defaults['site_active']=true;$defaults['wallet_card_activate']='false';$defaults['payment_card_activate']='false';
    echo json_encode(['database'=>$db->getDatabaseName(),'url'=>$url,'settings_defaults'=>$defaults],JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR).PHP_EOL;
}catch(Throwable $e){fwrite(STDERR,preg_match('/^GO_OWNER_[A-Z_]+$/D',$e->getMessage())?$e->getMessage().PHP_EOL:"GO_OWNER_CENTRAL_SETUP_FAILED\n");exit(1);}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
ini_set('display_errors','0');ini_set('log_errors','0');
$phase='BOOTSTRAP';
try{
    if(PHP_SAPI!=='cli'||$argc!==3||!in_array($argv[2],['initialize','health','queue','schedule','isolation','crud'],true))throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_CONSOLE_ARGUMENTS');
    require '/home/fasakha/public_html/vendor/autoload.php';
    $r=\App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Bootstrap::read($argv[1],$argv[2]==='initialize'||$argv[2]==='health');
    $app=\App\Services\OwnerDashboards\Bootstrap::application($r);
    $kernel=$app->make(\Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class);$kernel->bootstrap();
    $db=$app->make('db')->connection();
    if($db->getDatabaseName()!==$r['database']||$db->getConfig('username')!==$r['db_user'])throw new RuntimeException('GO_OWNER_DATABASE_BINDING_MISMATCH');
    if($argv[2]==='initialize'){
        $phase='CONFIGURATION';
        // Cache only this clean environment. Never copy the primary application's cached configuration.
        $configuration=$app['config']->all();
        file_put_contents($r['base'].'/bootstrap/cache/config.php','<?php return '.var_export($configuration,true).';'.PHP_EOL,LOCK_EX);
        echo "GO_OWNER_TENANT_INITIALIZED\n";
    }elseif($argv[2]==='health'){
